title: Alex Karp says he's a lifelong Democrat — and Palantir's products are 'essentially progressive'
excerpt: Palantir CEO Alex Karp told Politico that he's a lifelong Democrat, and that President Donald Trump mishandled immigration.
content_html:
By Henry Chandonnet

You're currently following this author! Click to unsubscribe from email alerts.

After the "blunami," Alex Karp is talking up his ties to the Democrats.

The Palantir CEO once described wokeness as a "thin pagan religion" and called Democrats irresponsible and childish. Meanwhile, he praised President Donald Trump as a model for entrepreneurs.

In a Wednesday interview with Politico — Business Insider's sister company — Karp reaffirmed his left-leaning politics.

"I've been a Democrat my whole life," Karp told Politico. "I know more about being a progressive than almost anybody on the planet, and I absolutely believe Palantir — all of our products are essentially progressive."

Karp has long called himself an "unhappy Democrat," criticizing both what he calls the "Mamdani wing" and the "woke right."

Karp continued to criticize the Democratic Socialists of America in the interview. He said that they "gaslight Jews and segregate Blacks."

The declaration may surprise onlookers who know Palantir for its immigration enforcement platform, the so-called "ImmigrationOS." The company has long been criticized for its business with Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

Palantir's work with ICE has sparked protests and sowed internal division.

In the Politico interview, Karp said that Trump mishandled his immigration crackdown. "I was really happy to hear the president be honest that — you know, his words, I believe, were something like, 'Yeah, we kinda went too far,'" he said.

The Palantir CEO tied it back to economic justice — and the future of capitalism.

Democrats aren't beholden to the belief that capitalism will solve all problems, Karp said. "Maybe that was once true. I never thought it was true. It's definitely not true now."
